title: Quantum Velocity
description:
Quantum Velocity is an anti-gravity combat racer. Race hover pods at blistering speed, blast rivals with weapons and shields, leave the road behind on wild alien planets, and hunt giant titans across an open world.

COMBAT RACING

Every race is a fight. Arm your pod with weapons, utilities and shields, lock on to rivals and knock them out of the race. Or play it clean in pure racing mode.

[list]

• 9 weapons, 5 utilities and shields

• Quick Race, Time Trial, Elimination and Battle modes

• Smart AI rivals with their own racing styles

25 CIRCUITS ACROSS 5 WORLDS

Tear through neon cities, desert canyons, ice fields, magma foundries and orbital stations. Drift through corners, chain boosts and ride the slipstream to the front.

• Career mode: 5 cups, each ending in a boss race

• Drift, boost, slipstream and side-dash

• Beat each cup's boss to unlock the next

THE OFFROAD LEAGUE

No roads. No rails. Just raw alien terrain. Launch off ramps, soar over lava chasms and ride erupting geysers into the sky.

• 25 offroad courses across 5 alien planets

• Huge jumps, chasms, geysers and full combat

• A boss race at the end of every cup

EXPLORE AN OPEN WORLD

Drive freely across 5 huge alien planets. Each one is full of monster packs to battle with your pod's weapons, and each hides a titan you must find.

• 5 open planets to explore

• Huge numbers of alien monster packs

• Earn credits and materials as you go

HUNT THE TITANS (Early Version/Experimental)

Every planet is ruled by a massive titan. Defeat it to claim the material you need to warp to the next world. Then face the final mega boss waiting on the last planet.

BUILD YOUR LEGEND

• 125 hover pods to unlock and upgrade

• A skill tree for every pod

• Custom weapon loadouts

• 119 paint jobs

• In-game achievements to earn

• Full keyboard and controller support
description_short: Quantum Velocity is an anti-gravity combat racing game. Arm your hover pod and race rivals on 25 neon circuits, jump chasms in the Offroad League, and explore five alien planets full of monsters as you hunt giant titans.
